text: Interactive Candlestick Charts: Visualize cryptocurrency price movements open, high, low, close data Real-Time Market Data: Live prices market statistics top 100 cryptocurrencies, refreshed every 10 minutes Historical Analysis: View historical price data dating back 2013 Advanced Filtering: Live search functionality quickly find cryptocurrency Multiple Timeframes: Flexible date range selectors (7 days -time) custom range slider Volume Analysis: Dedicated volume charts track trading activity Moving Averages Drawdown: 50- 200-day moving averages price chart, chart far price -time high Market Metrics: Comprehensive market data including market cap, dominance, 24h/7d/30d/60d/90d price changes Color-Coded Performance: Heat-map style coloring quick visual identification price movements Coin Comparison: Compare 10 coins, prices normalized start 100 Market Treemap: top 100 coins sized market cap colored 24h change Returns Calendar: Monthly returns year coin Light Dark Mode: Switch toggle navigation bar CSV Downloads: Download data behind every tab CSV file

title: Interactive Cryptocurrency Time Series and Market Data Explorer
text: Market data provided CoinMarketCap API. Price histories downloaded crypto2 kept disk R sessions, folder given tools::R_user_dir("crypto", "cache"). CoinMarketCap sends 400 days per request, first download coin’s full history takes 13 requests; , days since last download fetched, single request. keep downloads somewhere else, set options(crypto.cache_dir = "path//folder"), delete folder start . CoinMarketCap pauses clients send many requests short time. happens R console shows Retrying 60 seconds chart appears minute later.

Create .Renviron file package folder COINMARKETCAP_APIKEY=-api-key. uploaded app never committed, .gitignore lists . Connect account , rsconnect::setAccountInfo() line Account, Tokens shinyapps.io. Run rsconnect::deployApp(appName = "golemcrypto") package folder, open app.R RStudio click Publish.
